text:
elena: noticing a surge of 502/504s from hosted inference since ~09:10 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts on text-gen endpoints. logs show cache prefix errors referencing memcached nodes. :rotating_light:
raj: yep we're getting a handful of alerts too. Nginx upstream_timeouts + gateway 504s correlated with kv-prefix calls returning errors.
jessica: stack traces from gateway: 
```
  2026-03-17T09:12:04Z ERROR gateway request_id=abc123 upstream=kv-prefix-err: connection reset by peer
  2026-03-17T09:12:04Z WARN  runtime route=hosted/generate backend=memcached prefix_lookup=fail
```
elena: repro (from internal test account):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Client-Request: repro-331" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}' -w "%{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null
# returns 504 with short body "gateway timeout"
```
raj: interestingly only requests with prefix caching enabled (/route uses prefix=kgen:) are failing; direct bypass (cache=false) succeeds. Could be auth/rotation or network flakiness to memcached pool.
oncall-sre: I'm on it, spinning up a quick check against memcached ring. Seeing auth failure rate spikes in metrics: SASL auth errors -> 401 from memcached?
sam: stack from proxy shows memcached auth handshake TTL exceeded: 
```
ERR: memcached_auth_fail rate 0.37 > threshold
socket_timeout during SASL_STEP
```
sara: any config changes recently? We rotated KMS keys yesterday for memcached credentials but rollout was gradual. Might be a timing window where clients tried old creds.
elena: that would line up with the first errors at 09:08 when key rotation batch 4 started. We need an immediate mitigation for customer-facing API.
jessica: mitigation options: 1) disable prefix caching at gateway for hosted-routes via remote flag (fast), 2) increase memcached client retry/backoff to mask transient auth failures (risky), 3) roll back KMS rotation or reissue creds to pool (longer).
oncall-sre: doing #1 now — enabling feature flag `disable_prefix_cache_for_hosted` for prod (all regions) to route around memcached. Will post when toggled.
infra-bot: feature flag toggle request queued by oncall-sre (id ff-7782).
oncall-sre: toggled flag at 09:18 UTC. Immediate drop in 5xxs on dashboards. Confirming 200s for test repro.
raj: confirming client repro now returns 200. Not seeing SASL errors creeping up.
sam: created internal incident INC-2026-0317 and linked support ticket #S-4421 for affected customers.
sara: follow-up actions: audit KMS rotation logs for partial rollout, ensure credential hot-swap compatibility, add a canary to rotation that fails closed, and add circuit-breaker to prefix cache calls so gateway returns soft-fallback instead of 5xx.
elena: I'll draft customer comms for those affected and offer temporary quota credits. Thanks everyone. :heart:
jessica: will schedule postmortem and add retention of memcached auth metrics for 30d.
oncall-sre: monitoring alert thresholds adjusted; re-open if reoccurs.
